name: When should I consider pipe replacement instead of just a repair?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider pipe replacement instead of just a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider pipe replacement if your plumbing system experiences frequent leaks, if the existing pipes are old and corroded, or if a leak is part of a larger systemic issue. While a single repair can address an isolated problem, widespread deterioration suggests that replacement would be a more cost-effective and long-term solution to prevent future failures and protect your property from ongoing damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement for frequent leaks, old or corroded pipes, or systemic issues. Replacement offers a more cost-effective, long-term solution than repeated repairs for widespread deterioration.
